# Open review: Saluca Labs research

> Public peer review of Saluca Labs papers and the claims Check the Record episodes make about them, through a GitHub issue form, plus the log of every correction we have made. No licence has been chosen yet.

There is no code here. A review is a GitHub issue opened from the Review form and labelled `review`; blank issues are turned off. Corrections cite each paper by its Zenodo concept DOI, never a version DOI.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/saluca-labs/open-review/blob/main/README.md): how to send a review, what happens to it, what is in scope
- [CORRECTIONS.md](https://github.com/saluca-labs/open-review/blob/main/CORRECTIONS.md): every correction and review outcome, newest first

## Code

- [Review issue form](https://github.com/saluca-labs/open-review/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/review.yml): the fields a review must fill
- [Issue template config](https://github.com/saluca-labs/open-review/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml): blank issues disabled

## Optional

- [Open a review](https://github.com/saluca-labs/open-review/issues/new?template=review.yml): the form itself
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/saluca-labs/open-review/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for agents editing this repo
- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/saluca-labs/open-review/blob/main/llms-full.txt): this header plus README.md and CORRECTIONS.md in full
